endpoint_receipt.conclusion: Declared/common endpoint factors agree; v7/v9 use identical kernels. v8 default and informed share endpoint factors but only informed enforces the continuous exchange support bound. Interpret differences with that known kernel qualification until trajectory checks establish impact.

limitations: Old baseline can admit marks with zero continuous numerical environment density despite finite analytic target intensity; informed arm has a support guard. Occurrence in these trajectories is unknown. Differences cannot be attributed solely to informed mass.
Matching declared endpoint factors do not certify the old transition kernels or finite-RNG exactness; corrected source is a separate experiment.
Eight independent populations provide estimated ratio MCSE, not proof against shared rare-mode bias.
F32 control expectation unknown; F64 reweighting changes numerical measure and zero expectation is continuous-model qualified.
